name: Multica
description: Native Multica admin console in Paseo: issues, kanban, projects, team, chat, automation, inbox, execution logs and workspace settings, for the official cloud and self-hosted servers, with a dismissible GitHub issue/PR co-creation banner.

zh-CN.name: Multica
zh-CN.description: 在 Paseo 中原生复刻 Multica 管理后台：任务、看板、项目、团队、聊天、自动化、收件箱、执行日志与工作区设置，支持官方云与自建 Multica 服务器；概览页带可关闭并记住状态的 GitHub 共创横幅
